content:
**Drop Site G3** is a location in the Cranberry Bog region of Appalachia. It can be found north of Thunder Mountain Substation TM-02 and east of Superior Sunset Farm. 

One of several Atomic Mining Services drop sites scattered throughout the Cranberry Bog, where the company experimented with nuclear charges dropped down mine shafts to generate Ultracite.

This gated bunker has sunken into the ground and is now almost entirely flooded with Toxic Water. Machinery is strewn about inside, and there is little of note here besides a few containers that can be looted.

Drop Site G3 appears in *Fallout 76*.
